title: Dragon Diner Skull Girl
description: A vibrant surreal scene inside a retro diner featuring a woman with a split pink and yellow skull head, wearing a pink bikini and green dragon wings, seated in a red booth while holding a glowing smartphone. On the table is an open menu, a plate of pink pie, a coffee mug, and a small green dragon, with a piano, musical notes, and a mirror reflection in the background.
